newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still an outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still an outperform.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter said it has reiterated its outperform rating on Brazilian telecoms giant Telebras with a one-year target price of $180.
-- Morgan Stanley analyst Luiz Carvalho said in a report Telebras' second-quarter earnings of $2.30 per share were slightly above his estimate of $2.24 and below the consensus of $2.53.
"Operating results were solid, in our view, showing good revenue and further efficiency gains," he wrote.
-- He said operating margins continue to expand to reach an all-time high of 37.4 percent, which was in line with expectations.

-- Telebras continues to offer "attractive valuation levels, strong earnings growth potential and positive regulatory momentum," he said, adding the share is on track to meet his earnings estimates of $10.76 for 1997 and $12.59 for 1998.
-- "Telebras remains one of the most attractive stocks in Latin America," Carvalho wrote, adding recent share price volatility "has no relationship with the company's operating outlook."

-- Telebras' ADR was down 4-1/16 at 136-1/8 in New York while its preferred share was off 2.96 percent at 147.50 reais and its common was off 3.94 percent at 134 reais in Sao Paulo at 1119 local/1019 edt/1419 gmt.
